content.shloka:
Kausalyā Suprajā Rāma Pūrvā Sandhyā Pravartatē
Uttiṣṭha Naraśārdūla Kartavyaṁ Daivam Āhnikam
content.meaning: O Rama, the worthy son of Kausalya, the dawn is approaching. Arise, O tiger among men, the daily divine duties await.
content.transliteration:
Kausalyā Suprajā Rāma Pūrvā Sandhyā Pravartatē
Uttiṣṭha Naraśārdūla Kartavyaṁ Daivam Āhnikam

content.shloka:
Śrī Vēṅkaṭēśa Suprabhātam Ārabhyatē
Śrīman Abhīṣṭa Varadākhila Lōka Bandhō
Śrī Śrīnivāsa Jagadēka Dayaika Sindhō
content.meaning: The Suprabhatam of Lord Venkateshwara begins. O auspicious one, bestower of all desires, friend of all worlds, O Srinivasa, the sole ocean of compassion for the universe.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Vēṅkaṭēśa Suprabhātam Ārabhyatē
Śrīman Abhīṣṭa Varadākhila Lōka Bandhō
Śrī Śrīnivāsa Jagadēka Dayaika Sindhō

content.shloka:
Śrī Vēṅkaṭāchalapate Tava Suprabhātam
Brahmādayaḥ Suravaraganāḥ Samahṛṣyā
Santas Sanandana Mukhāstatvaṁ Praṇamanti
content.meaning: O Lord of Venkatachala, good morning to You! Brahma and the host of gods, along with the saints headed by Sanandana, bow before You with joy.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Vēṅkaṭācalapate Tava Suprabhātam
Brahmādayaḥ Suravaraganāḥ Samahṛṣyā
Santas Sanandana Mukhāstatvaṁ Praṇamanti

content.shloka:
Lakṣmī Nivāsa Niravadya Guṇaika Sindhō
Saṁsāra Sāgara Samuttaraṇaika Setō
Vēdānta Vēdya Nijavaibhava Bhakta Bhōgya
Śrī Vēṅkaṭāchalapate Tava Suprabhātam
content.meaning: O abode of Lakshmi, ocean of flawless virtues, the sole bridge to cross the ocean of worldly existence, known through Vedanta, whose glories are enjoyed by devotees — O Lord of Venkatachala, good morning to You!
content.transliteration:
Lakṣmī Nivāsa Niravadya Guṇaika Sindhō
Saṁsāra Sāgara Samuttaraṇaika Setō
Vēdānta Vēdya Nijavaibhava Bhakta Bhōgya
Śrī Vēṅkaṭācalapate Tava Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Ānanda Rūpam Ajam Ēkam Ananta Mūrtim
Vaikunṭham Acyutam Aśeṣa Guṇaika Sindhum
Śrī Vēṅkaṭēśam Abhivādya Gṛhān Vrajāmi
Jayatu Jayatu Dēva Dayā Jaladhe
content.meaning: Having saluted Lord Venkateshwara, the unborn, the blissful form, the infinite, Vaikuntha, Achyuta, the ocean of all virtues — I return home. Victory, victory to the Lord, the ocean of compassion!
content.transliteration:
Ānanda Rūpam Ajam Ēkam Ananta Mūrtim
Vaikuṇṭham Acyutam Aśeṣa Guṇaika Sindhum
Śrī Vēṅkaṭēśam Abhivādya Gṛhān Vrajāmi
Jayatu Jayatu Dēva Dayā Jaladhe

content.shloka:
Kausalyā Suprajā Rāma Pūrvā Sandhyā Pravartatē
Uttiṣṭha Naraśārdūla Kartavyaṁ Daivam Āhnikam
content.meaning: O Rama, the noble son of Kausalya, the morning twilight has arrived. Arise, O tiger among men, for divine daily duties must be performed.
content.transliteration:
Kausalyā Suprajā Rāma Pūrvā Sandhyā Pravartatē
Uttiṣṭha Naraśārdūla Kartavyaṁ Daivam Āhnikam

content.shloka:
Uttiṣṭha Uttiṣṭha Govinda Uttiṣṭha Garuḍadhvaja
Uttiṣṭha Kamalākānta Trailōkyaṁ Maṅgalaṁ Kuru
content.meaning: Arise, arise, O Govinda! Arise, O bearer of the Garuda banner! Arise, O beloved of Kamala, and bestow auspiciousness upon the three worlds.
content.transliteration:
Uttiṣṭha Uttiṣṭha Govinda Uttiṣṭha Garuḍadhvaja
Uttiṣṭha Kamalākānta Trailōkyaṁ Maṅgalaṁ Kuru

content.shloka:
Mātastu Kausalyā Suprajātā Suputra
Sītā Rāmasya Dayitā Priyā Vanitā
Lakṣmaṇō Anucharo Bharataḥ Praṇāmī
content.meaning: Mother Kausalya, blessed with a noble son; Sita, the beloved consort of Rama; Lakshmana, the devoted follower; and Bharata, the humble worshiper.
content.transliteration:
Mātastu Kausalyā Suprajātā Suputra
Sītā Rāmasya Dayitā Priyā Vanitā
Lakṣmaṇō Anucarō Bharataḥ Praṇāmī

content.shloka:
Śrī Rāmachandra Charaṇau Manasā Smarāmi
Śrī Rāmachandra Charaṇau Vachasā Gṛṇāmi
Śrī Rāmachandra Charaṇau Śirasā Namāmi
Śrī Rāmachandra Suprabhātam
content.meaning: I remember the feet of Sri Ramachandra in my mind. I praise the feet of Sri Ramachandra with my words. I bow to the feet of Sri Ramachandra with my head. Good morning, Sri Ramachandra!
content.transliteration:
Śrī Rāmacandra Caraṇau Manasā Smarāmi
Śrī Rāmacandra Caraṇau Vacasā Gṛṇāmi
Śrī Rāmacandra Caraṇau Śirasā Namāmi
Śrī Rāmacandra Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Vasudēva Sutaṁ Dēvaṁ Kaṁsa Chāṇūra Mardanam
Dēvakī Paramānandaṁ Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagad Gurum
content.meaning: I worship Krishna, son of Vasudeva, slayer of Kamsa and Chanura, the supreme bliss of Devaki, and the Guru of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Vasudēva Sutaṁ Dēvaṁ Kaṁsa Cāṇūra Mardanam
Dēvakī Paramānandaṁ Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagad Gurum

content.shloka:
Uttiṣṭha Kṛṣṇa Gōvinda Uttiṣṭha Nanda Nandana
Uttiṣṭha Kamalākānta Uttiṣṭha Vraja Maṇḍana
content.meaning: Arise, O Krishna! Arise, O Govinda! Arise, O delight of Nanda! Arise, O beloved of Kamala! Arise, O ornament of Vraja!
content.transliteration:
Uttiṣṭha Kṛṣṇa Gōvinda Uttiṣṭha Nanda Nandana
Uttiṣṭha Kamalākānta Uttiṣṭha Vraja Maṇḍana

content.shloka:
Gōpī Gōpāla Bālānāṁ Prāṇa Vallabha Kēśava
Murali Dhara Mādhava Prātaḥ Suprabhātam Astu Tē
content.meaning: O Keshava, the beloved of the Gopis, Gopalas, and children! O Madhava, holder of the flute — may this morning be auspicious for You!
content.transliteration:
Gōpī Gōpāla Bālānāṁ Prāṇa Vallabha Kēśava
Murali Dhara Mādhava Prātaḥ Suprabhātam Astu Tē

content.shloka:
Mathurā Nagarī Ramyā Yamunā Tīra Vāsinē
Gōvardhanōddhāriṇē Namaḥ Śrī Kṛṣṇāya Suprabhātam
content.meaning: To the one who dwells on the banks of the Yamuna in the beautiful city of Mathura, to the lifter of Govardhana — salutations and good morning to Sri Krishna!
content.transliteration:
Mathurā Nagarī Ramyā Yamunā Tīra Vāsinē
Gōvardhanōddhāriṇē Namaḥ Śrī Kṛṣṇāya Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Prātaḥ Smarāmi Bhava Bhīti Haraṁ Surēśam
Gaṅgā Dharaṁ Vṛṣabha Vāhanam Ambikēśam
Khāṭvāṅga Śūla Varadam Abhayaṁ Karāgrē
Śrī Śambhavē Tava Suprabhātam
content.meaning: At dawn I remember the Lord of the gods who removes the fear of worldly existence, who bears the Ganga, rides the bull, and is Ambika's Lord — holding trident and granting boons and fearlessness. O Shambhu, good morning to You!
content.transliteration:
Prātaḥ Smarāmi Bhava Bhīti Haraṁ Surēśam
Gaṅgā Dharaṁ Vṛṣabha Vāhanam Ambikēśam
Khāṭvāṅga Śūla Varadaṁ Abhayaṁ Karāgrē
Śrī Śambhavē Tava Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Prātaḥ Namāmi Giriśaṁ Girijā Ardhadēham
Sarga Sthiti Pralaya Kāraṇam Ādidevam
Viśvēśvaraṁ Vijita Viśvam Anēka Mūrtim
content.meaning: At dawn I bow to the Lord of the mountain, who shares His body with Girija (Parvati), who is the primeval deity causing creation, sustenance, and dissolution — the Lord of the universe with infinite forms.
content.transliteration:
Prātaḥ Namāmi Giriśaṁ Girijā Ardhadēham
Sarga Sthiti Pralaya Kāraṇam Ādidēvam
Viśvēśvaraṁ Vijita Viśvam Anēka Mūrtim

content.shloka:
Kailāsa Śikhara Sthitam Umā Sahitam
Pañchavaktraṁ Daśa Bhujaṁ Trinayanam
Śaśāṅka Śēkharaṁ Jatā Mukuṭa Maṇḍitam
Śrī Mahādevāya Suprabhātam
content.meaning: Seated atop Mount Kailasa with Uma, five-faced, ten-armed, three-eyed, crowned with the crescent moon, adorned with matted locks — good morning to Sri Mahadeva!
content.transliteration:
Kailāsa Śikhara Sthitam Umā Sahitam
Pañcavaktraṁ Daśa Bhujaṁ Trinayanam
Śaśāṅka Śēkharaṁ Jaṭā Mukuṭa Maṇḍitam
Śrī Mahādēvāya Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Nandī Samīpe Vṛṣabha Vāhana Priya
Gaṇēśa Skanda Janaka Śiva Śaṅkara
Bhasma Vibhūṣita Digambara Mṛtyuñjaya
Śrī Kāśī Viśvanāthāya Suprabhātam
content.meaning: Near Nandi, the one who loves His bull vehicle, father of Ganesha and Skanda, Shiva-Shankara, adorned with ash, sky-clad, conqueror of death — good morning to Sri Kashi Vishwanath!
content.transliteration:
Nandī Samīpe Vṛṣabha Vāhana Priya
Gaṇēśa Skanda Janaka Śiva Śaṅkara
Bhasma Vibhūṣita Digambara Mṛtyuñjaya
Śrī Kāśī Viśvanāthāya Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Prātaḥ Smarāmi Sarasīruha Lōchanāṁ Tāṁ
Sindūra Bindu Tilakāṅkita Bhāla Dēśām
Kuṅkuma Rañjita Karāṁ Kamalēkṣaṇāṁ Tām
Śrī Jagadambikāyai Suprabhātam
content.meaning: At dawn I remember Her with lotus eyes, Her forehead adorned with a vermillion mark, Her hands colored with saffron, with lotus-like eyes — good morning to the Mother of the universe!
content.transliteration:
Prātaḥ Smarāmi Sarasīruha Lōcanāṁ Tāṁ
Sindūra Bindu Tilakāṅkita Bhāla Dēśām
Kuṅkuma Rañjita Karāṁ Kamalēkṣaṇāṁ Tām
Śrī Jagadambikāyai Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Uttiṣṭha Dēvi Jagadambike Prātaḥ Kāle
Uttiṣṭha Mahālakṣmi Uttiṣṭha Sarasvatī
Uttiṣṭha Durgā Bhavānī Śive Pāhimām
content.meaning: Arise, O Mother of the world, at the dawn hour! Arise, Mahalakshmi! Arise, Sarasvati! Arise, Durga, Bhavani, Shive — protect me!
content.transliteration:
Uttiṣṭha Dēvi Jagadambike Prātaḥ Kāle
Uttiṣṭha Mahālakṣmi Uttiṣṭha Sarasvatī
Uttiṣṭha Durgā Bhavānī Śive Pāhimām

content.shloka:
Siṁha Vāhinī Mahiṣāsura Mardinī
Śaṅkha Chakra Gadā Padma Dhāriṇī
Sarva Maṅgala Māṅgalye Śive
Śrī Lalitāmbikāyai Suprabhātam
content.meaning: Rider of the lion, slayer of Mahishasura, bearer of conch, disc, mace, and lotus, the auspicious among all that is auspicious, Shive — good morning to Sri Lalitambika!
content.transliteration:
Siṁha Vāhinī Mahiṣāsura Mardinī
Śaṅkha Cakra Gadā Padma Dhāriṇī
Sarva Maṅgala Māṅgalye Śive
Śrī Lalitāmbikāyai Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Yā Dēvī Sarvabhūtēṣu Śakti Rūpēṇa Saṁsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ
Śrī Ādi Parāśaktyai Suprabhātam
content.meaning: To that Goddess who abides in all beings as Shakti (power) — salutations to Her thrice, again and again. Good morning to the primordial supreme power!
content.transliteration:
Yā Dēvī Sarvabhūtēṣu Śakti Rūpēṇa Saṁsthitā
Namastasyai Namastasyai Namastasyai Namo Namaḥ
Śrī Ādi Parāśaktyai Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Uttiṣṭha Vāyu Tanaya Prātaḥ Kāla Samāgatē
Rāma Sēvā Parō Nityaṁ Hanūman Suprabhātam
content.meaning: Arise, O son of Vayu, the dawn has arrived! O Hanuman, ever devoted to the service of Rama — good morning!
content.transliteration:
Uttiṣṭha Vāyu Tanaya Prātaḥ Kāla Samāgatē
Rāma Sēvā Parō Nityaṁ Hanūman Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Añjanā Nandana Vīra Bala Buddhi Vidyā Dhanam
Mahāvīra Vikrama Bajrangi Mahābalī
Rāma Dūta Atulita Baladāma Suprabhātam
content.meaning: O son of Anjana, endowed with valor, strength, wisdom, and knowledge! O Mahavira of great prowess, O Bajrangi of immense strength! O messenger of Rama with incomparable power — good morning!
content.transliteration:
Añjanā Nandana Vīra Bala Buddhi Vidyā Dhanam
Mahāvīra Vikrama Bajraṅgī Mahābalī
Rāma Dūta Atulita Baladāma Suprabhātam

content.shloka:
Laṅkā Dahana Saṅjīvanī Ānayana Prabhō
Sītā Śōka Nivāraṇa Rāma Priya Bhakta
Aṣṭa Siddhi Nava Nidhi Kē Dātā
content.meaning: O Lord who burned Lanka and brought the Sanjivani herb! Remover of Sita's sorrow, dear devotee of Rama, bestower of the eight Siddhis and nine Nidhis.
content.transliteration:
Laṅkā Dahana Sañjīvanī Ānayana Prabhō
Sītā Śōka Nivāraṇa Rāma Priya Bhakta
Aṣṭa Siddhi Nava Nidhi Kē Dātā

content.shloka:
Manōjavaṁ Māruta Tulya Vēgam
Jitēndriyaṁ Buddhi Matāṁ Variṣṭham
Vāta Ātmajaṁ Vānara Yūtha Mukhyam
Śrī Rāma Dūtaṁ Śaraṇaṁ Prapadyē
Śrī Hanumate Suprabhātam
content.meaning: I take refuge in the one swift as thought, fast as the wind, master of the senses, foremost among the wise, son of Vayu, chief of the Vanara army, the messenger of Sri Rama. Good morning to Hanuman!
content.transliteration:
Manōjavaṁ Māruta Tulya Vēgam
Jitēndriyaṁ Buddhi Matāṁ Variṣṭham
Vāta Ātmajaṁ Vānara Yūtha Mukhyam
Śrī Rāma Dūtaṁ Śaraṇaṁ Prapadyē
Śrī Hanumatē Suprabhātam
